Now, Amazon's parents are high upper-middle class and not only rent out a very nice four bed, two bath house for her and her boyfriend to live in, but will also gladly give her the funding for pretty much whatever she wants so long as she stays in school. So it's sure to be a kick-ass party, and how could I not a good time with one of my best friends? I accept, and head up to her house early to help decorate, prepare food, mix up punchbowls full of alcoholic beverages, etc.

At maybe 9:30 people start showing up. There's a friendly goth couple, the female component of which shows up in full-on ravewear, two or three neckbeard friends of Amazon's boyfriend, and... Fluffy. Now, I've seen some whomping whales in my day, but I'm wholeheartedly blown away by the sheer size and.. General roundness of this one. Barely five feet tall and easily 325lbs, she's almost sphereical and literally has to position her body at just the right angle to even fit through the goddamn door. Unevenly cropped blonde hair clings to her head in a jagged and greasy attempt at a pixie cut, framing cheeks sufficiently wider than her forehead and the most vacant, thoughtless eyes you've ever seen.

Fluffy arrives, as elephants often do, in a herd: she's with two highly unimpressionable minimoon Tumblrina types and a very attractive meterosexual looking guy about my age. Amazon notices me trying to break the ice and comes over to acquaint me with everyone including Fluffy, who just grunts a sour hello.

Drinks start pouring, music starts playing, and everyone's getting into party mode. To be honest I'm a rather shy and introverted person, and was a little nervous about attending a party where I'd only know two people... But I fit in with Amazon's crowd like a charm (cute boy and I are especially hitting it off, he's been hanging around me pretty much the entire party and it turns out we have a ton in common). Even Fluffy doesn't seem to mind me, and as a gesture of good will I make a bit of superficial conversation with it about Pokémon, anime, and the like.

Fast-forward a couple of hours and I'm sitting on the couch with Amazon, goth girl, and cute boy, drinking vodka cranberry juice and watchimg a bunch of the guys fail at Guitar Hero. We're all pretty well buzzed at this point; just talking, laughing, and having a good time...

Being a little inebriated, it takes some time for the six of us to set up the tent (naturally, hammy does nothing during this time but sit on the couch with her pizza and watch), but once it's done it's so worth it and we all climb inside to relish in the fruits of our labour. Daily Devotional

December 13

34 Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?35 And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God. - Luke 1:34-35 (KJV)

 The Christmas Story continues. This was a normal question to ask, and it did not show unbelief on Mary’s part. Zacharias, John the Baptist father, asked the angel a similar question (Luke 1:18), and was struck dumb, and unable to speak, until John was born, because he asked in unbelief, not believing what the angel told him. It is not wrong to question God on how to do something, if your question is for your understanding, and not because you don’t believe God. I believe any virgin woman would want to know how she could possibly become pregnant, without a man being involved. Historians say that Mary was a teenager at this time, and she puzzled at the fact that she would be the mother of Jesus, the Messiah.

 This is one of the most profound statements in the bible, for who but God, would have come up with the Holy Ghost being the father of Jesus. Even though Isaiah prophesized it would happen (Isaiah 7:14), I don’t think anyone believed it until now. What an awesome God we have, and how marvelous His way of thinking must be. Jesus was truly the Son of God, as God through the Holy Ghost actually fathered Him, and that means that the very blood of God flowed in the veins of Jesus as the father is the one that determines the blood type of his offspring. Jesus, being called the Son of God, was not symbolic, as some have tried to say, but was an actual fact, as shown by this scripture. Praise God for His plan of redemption for us, His creation.
